purpose: Teach: 率いる/解っ/おこなっ/御座い/ことごとく/いたす/こんなにも/みつけ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活で部員率いる役だな
lines.en: So you're the one running the club now, huh?
lines.style: Teasing, direct opening. Leans back slightly. Light and probing—watching to see how he reacts. Quick pace, familiar.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、数学の問題、解ってきたな、桜
lines.en: You know, you've really gotten the hang of math problems lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment, almost careful. Quiet pride underneath. Steady eye contact. Not showy—just stating a fact he noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭の出し物おこなっただろ
lines.en: Wait—didn't you actually do a performance at the culture festival?
lines.style: Surprise breaking through. Quick pivot. Accusatory but playful—catching him in something. Slight rise at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「ありがとう御座います」って先生に丁寧だな、桜
lines.en: You've been so polite with the teachers lately—'thank you very much' and all that. Something up?
lines.style: Dry, knowing smirk in the voice. Not quite mocking. The humor of someone watching a friend perform. Measured, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宿題をことごとく終わらせたな
lines.en: You finished basically every single homework assignment, didn't you?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact praise. No sugar. Direct acknowledgment of effort. Straightforward delivery, slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「お願いいたす」って改まったな、桜
lines.en: Now you're using formal language like 'if you would be so kind'? That's not like you.
lines.style: Dry amusement. The tone of someone noting something slightly off without making it a big deal. Relaxed but pointed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、こんなにも勉強したのに、テスト難しかった
lines.en: You studied this much and the test was still that hard?
lines.style: Frustration with a hint of humor. Slight disbelief in the voice. Not angry at him—at the unfairness. Quick cadence, genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、机の引き出しに古い写真みつけてたな、桜
lines.en: I found those old photos in your desk drawer. Where did those come from?
lines.style: Close, intimate curiosity. Gentle probing—not accusatory. Warm but direct. The tone of someone asking about something that matters.
